blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – What started as a simple initiative to give local basketball players in Leyte a platform to showcase their talent has grown into a grassroots basketball program reaching communities across Eastern Visayas. For Juvinille Parmis, founder of Ka-DAYO Sports, the goal has always been bigger than organizing tournaments. Now entering its ninth season, the Ka-DAYO x CSAS Developmental Basketball Tournament is targeting more than 100 participating teams from cities and provinces across Eastern Visayas as it opens on Saturday, November 14, in Ormoc City.
